title: Mapo Tofu
description: Soft tofu in a glossy, fiery sauce of chilli bean paste and fermented black beans, with crisp pork and the numbing tingle of Sichuan pepper.
notes: Pixian doubanjiang is the one ingredient not to substitute. Leave out the pork and use mushroom stock for a vegetarian version.

steps.text: Bring a pan of water to a simmer with the salt, slide in the tofu for a minute to firm it, then drain gently.
steps.tip: Salted water seasons the tofu and sets its surface, so the cubes survive the sauce.

steps.text: Fry the minced pork in the neutral oil until crisp and browned.
Lower the heat, add the doubanjiang, and fry until the oil turns red. Add the black beans, chilli flakes, garlic, and ginger.
Pour in the stock and soy sauce, add the tofu, and nudge it in with the back of a spatula rather than stirring. Simmer.
Stir the cornstarch into the water and add it in two or three additions, until the sauce clings.
steps.tip: All at once makes a paste. In stages you can stop the moment it glosses.

steps.text: Serve with rice, scattered with the ground Sichuan peppercorns and green onions.
